total_model.summary: Model projects 43.5 total points (JAX 29, TEN 15). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.3), Divisional game (lowers total 0.8), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
